html:
Unique Research · Event signup · March 8, 2024

The Berkshire Hathaway Annual Meeting — the investors’ pilgrimage — arrives again in Omaha. With Buffett’s era shifting, many frame 2024 as a rare chance to hear him in person on equities, Fed policy, gold, real estate, and capital allocation. ~50,000 attendees; six-hour Q&A; Buffett–Gates table tennis and other side events. Over half a century Buffett & Munger built Berkshire into a >$500B AUM compounder (~18,261× cumulative return cited in CN text).

Parallel track: Silicon Valley AI immersion — OpenAI-frontier exchange, Stanford AI research, AI-app founders, plus a Silicon Valley AI project demo day linking local founders and investors for overseas fundraising and GTM ideas. Soft landing: Napa Valley wine country for a mid-week cultural reset.

Dates in Chinese title: May 3–9, 2024 · Silicon Valley–Omaha dual arc. No signup URL invented here — charts/QR attach on ingest.

Highlights

  • Berkshire AGM (59th) — May 2024, Omaha Central Link; 40,000+ from 200+ countries in a typical year
  • Buffett / Gates adjacency — “Invest in Yourself” 5K (Buffett starts the race / awards); table tennis & bridge; jewelry-selling stunt; lunch-restaurant experience
  • OpenAI application frontier — Microsoft’s >$13B commitment through 2023; ChatGPT then 2024 Sora video model as context
  • Stanford AI coursework / research exchange
  • Silicon Valley AI pitch day — founders ↔ investors
  • Napa and other cultural experiences

7 CN images; attach on ingest. Signup details / itinerary boards in CN package.

— END —
